body.name: support-aware recursive completeness handle
body.construction: The support-aware handle consists of the retained normalized carrier, the sole input-determined task compiler, and exactly the four transition relations \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}}\), and \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\). The compiler recomputes its agenda from the current graph and labelled kernels: it scans actually present supported-context gates, then applies the fixed recursive order of terminal marginalization, nonancestor restriction or intervention augmentation, district splitting, and the prescribed-complement fixing recursion, and otherwise emits the explicit residual state. Polynomial constraints and the positivity ledger travel with every task. Neither a successful external derivation nor a verifier-accepted residual candidate is an input to agenda construction.
